blocks.content: The Food Corporation of India (FCI) is one of India’s most important public sector organizations responsible for ensuring national food security. It plays a central role in procurement, storage, distribution of food grains, and maintenance of buffer stocks.
The Food Corporation of India (FCI) is one of India’s most important public sector organizations responsible for ensuring national food security.

items: FCI's primary statutory objective is safeguarding national food security.
Four essential functional pillars of FCI: procurement, storage, distribution, and maintenance of buffer stocks.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: FCI is a key public sector organization tasked with maintaining national food security in India.
It actively manages the procurement, storage, and distribution of food grains across the country.
Maintaining strategic buffer stocks is one of its essential operational responsibilities.
